question: Which subdomains are regulatory hotspots (covered by 3 or more regulations)?
cypher: MATCH (sd:SubDomain) WHERE sd.regulationCount >= 3 RETURN sd.subDomainId, sd.name, sd.regulationCount, sd.coveringRegulations AS regulations ORDER BY sd.regulationCount DESC;
